subject: Horizon Health RFI — phased deployment plan, staffing, and rollback lanes
messages:

Cc: Procurement <procurement@horizonhealth.com>

Subject: RFI follow-up: detailed execution sequencing and staff responsibilities

Ben —

Thanks for the RFI packet. Our technical committee has one remaining ask before we move to procurement: can you provide a phased deployment matrix that maps timeline, integration milestones, point-of-contact responsibilities, and fallback/rollback criteria? Specifically:

- A 12-week example schedule for pilot -> staged rollout -> GA.
- Which Horizon teams need to be engaged at each gate (networking, security, app owners).
- What Redwood staffing (roles and FTE commitment) are required during pilot and cutover windows.
- Clear canary criteria and automated rollback triggers we can insert into our runbooks.

If you can provide a single-slide summary plus a detailed spreadsheet we'll include it in our vendor evaluation memo this week.

Regards,
James Lewis
Director, Platform Integrations
Horizon Health

James —

Thanks for the note and the specific asks. Attached is a workbook (Horizon_Implementation_Pacing.xlsx) with: an executive timeline (12-week sample), milestone definitions, team engagement matrix, staffing assumptions, and a rollback checklist. Below is an executive summary — I put the pilot cadence and canary gates up front so your committee can see the safety controls.

Executive summary (single-slide style):
- Weeks 1–2: Kickoff + environment prep. Redwood provides one Engagement Lead (0.2 FTE) and one Infra Engineer (0.5 FTE) during prep. Horizon required: network lead + security contact.
- Weeks 3–5: Pilot (internal traffic subset): integrate via mutual-auth API + sample dataset. Canary gate: 24h stability, <2% model failure rate, latency P95 below agreed SLO. Automated rollback triggers: repeated evictions in KV cache (>3 errors/5m) OR spike in 5xxs >1% sustained 10m — triggers auto-failover to verified fallback model variant. Redwood can script the failover as part of the runbook.
- Weeks 6–8: Staged rollout by tenant cluster (10% -> 40% -> 75%). Each step has a 48–72h observation window and telemetry validation (error budget, token cost, inference latency, output-quality checks where applicable). Redwood provides Canary Monitoring Dashboards and a temporary extra on-call (1 Infra Eng, 0.6 FTE across the staged rollout) to support triage.
- Weeks 9–12: GA, acceptance testing, handoff to ops. Post-GA 30-day stabilization with weekly quality review and a joint rollback playbook rehearsal.

Key staffing notes:
- Pilot: Redwood: Engagement Lead (0.2 FTE), Infra Engineer (0.5 FTE), Applied ML (part-time consult 0.1 FTE). Horizon: network, security, app owner for the pilot tenant.
- Rollout: Redwood on-call escalation (1 Infra Engineer rotating, 0.6 FTE for 2 weeks), Solutions Architect for cutover window (0.25 FTE).

Security and compliance: we included a SOC2 evidence summary (SOC2-evidence-summary.pdf) and can pre-populate your questionnaire for the integration phase.

Next steps: I propose a 30-minute alignment call Monday to walk the slide and spreadsheet; if that works I’ll send calendar invites and the pre-read.

Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
Attachment: Horizon_Implementation_Pacing.xlsx; SOC2-evidence-summary.pdf

Subject: Final: phased deployment package + next steps

James / Horizon procurement —

Appended is the final package we discussed on the internal prep: Horizon_Implementation_Pacing.xlsx (includes the 12-week sample schedule and the staffing matrix), Integration_API_Specs.zip, and SOC2-evidence-summary.pdf. Key callouts:

- Pilot gating criteria (Week 3–5): explicit telemetry thresholds (latency P95 target, 5xx ceiling, failure-rate floor), plus a QA prompt-set evaluation for output-quality regression checks. If any gating metric fails for a sustained 10-minute window, our automated policy triggers: (1) roll to verified fallback model variant; (2) scale down new request routing to 0% for affected tenant cluster; (3) create an incident in your Jira project with pre-populated context fields.
- Runbook rehearsals: we’ve scheduled two dry-run rehearsals during Week 2 (cutover dry-run) and Week 8 (roll-forward rehearsal) — dates in the spreadsheet.
- Staffing commitment: Redwood will staff an Engagement Lead and Solutions Architect across pilot and a rotating Infra on-call during rollout. Contact list and escalation matrix are in the sheet.

Next steps: please confirm which of the two DocuSign pre-approval forms you prefer (standard PO vs. committed-month reserved capacity); I included both links in the Drive folder. Once procurement confirms preferred commercial path we’ll lock the kickoff date.

If helpful, I can turn the executive slide into a one-page PDF to append to your vendor memo.

Best,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
Attachments: Horizon_Implementation_Pacing.xlsx; Integration_API_Specs.zip; SOC2-evidence-summary.pdf
